name: Proving Ground
description: Sandbox vehicle test field, 384 x 384 m: a spawn hub with the parts rack, gun bench, storage and ready-made vehicles; a 300 m drag strip with speed-trap gates; a banked oval; hill-climb ramps at 10, 20, 30 and 40 degrees; jumps; rough ground (washboard, rock garden, craters, a trench); a slalom and narrow gates; a gully with a bridge; a raised deck; a long tow grade; and a flat pad with a solid wall for crash tests.
author: Call of Slop

entities.name: THub
entities.text: PROVING GROUND: build area. The drag strip starts east; the sand run-off and ramps are signed.

entities.name: TRack
entities.text: Parts rack: take any part here.

entities.name: TTrap100
entities.text: SPEED TRAP at 100 m: read your Speed Gauge.

entities.name: TTrap200
entities.text: SPEED TRAP at 200 m: read your Speed Gauge.

entities.name: TTrap300
entities.text: SPEED TRAP at 300 m: read your Speed Gauge.

entities.name: TDragStart
entities.text: DRAG STRIP: start line. 300 m, a mark every 50 m.

entities.name: TDragEnd
entities.text: FINISH. 300 m. Sand run-off ahead.

entities.name: TOvalStart
entities.text: OVAL: start/finish. Turns are banked 15 degrees (east) and 25 degrees (west).

entities.name: TBankEast
entities.text: East turn: banked 15 degrees.

entities.name: TBankWest
entities.text: West turn: banked 25 degrees.

entities.name: TGate25
entities.text: Gate 2.5 m wide.

entities.name: TGate30
entities.text: Gate 3.0 m wide.

entities.name: TGate40
entities.text: Gate 4.0 m wide.

entities.name: TSlalom
entities.text: SLALOM: 9 m cones, then a tight one at 6 m. Gates after: 2.5, 3 and 4 m.

entities.name: TClimb10
entities.text: HILL CLIMB 10 degrees, up to a 10 m deck.

entities.name: TClimb20
entities.text: HILL CLIMB 20 degrees, up to a 10 m deck.

entities.name: TClimb30
entities.text: HILL CLIMB 30 degrees, up to a 10 m deck.

entities.name: TClimb40
entities.text: HILL CLIMB 40 degrees, up to a 10 m deck.

entities.name: TJump1
entities.text: JUMP 1: Small kicker, 0.8 m lip, 4 m gap, a 8 m landing.

entities.name: TJump2
entities.text: JUMP 2: Medium ramp, 2 m lip, 8 m gap, a 14 m landing.

entities.name: TJump3
entities.text: JUMP 3: Big ramp, 4 m lip, 16 m gap, a 24 m landing.

entities.name: TJump4
entities.text: JUMP 4: Huge ramp, 6 m lip, 30 m gap, a 36 m landing.

entities.name: TBumps
entities.text: BUMPS: rough ground.

entities.name: TCraters
entities.text: CRATER FIELD: shallow craters, 4 to 9 m across.

entities.name: TWashboard
entities.text: WASHBOARD: 3.6 m ridges.

entities.name: TRockGarden
entities.text: ROCK GARDEN: lumps and boulders.

entities.name: TTrench
entities.text: TRENCH: 6 m wide, 2 m deep.

entities.name: TTrench2
entities.text: Narrow trench: 3 m wide, 1.2 m deep.

entities.name: TBridge
entities.text: BRIDGE: 6 m wide over a 6 m gully.

entities.name: TGully
entities.text: GULLY: 22 m wide, 6 m deep. Cross by the bridge.

entities.name: TDeck
entities.text: RAISED DECK: 3 m up, reached by the narrow ramp.

entities.name: TDeckRamp
entities.text: NARROW RAMP: 2.5 m wide.

entities.name: TTowFoot
entities.text: TOW GRADE: 130 m long, rising 10 m (about 4.4 degrees).

entities.name: TTowTop
entities.text: Top of the tow grade: 10 m up.

entities.name: TPad
entities.text: CRASH PAD: open flat ground for big builds. The wall to the east is solid.

entities.name: TWall
entities.text: CRASH WALL: 5 m high, 3 m thick.
